channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama News Network (alabamanews.net)

item.title: Federal authorities announce an end to the immigration crackdown in Minnesota
item.description: Federal authorities say the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement sweeps focused on the Minneapolis-St. Paul metro area have led to the arrest of more than 4,000 people.

item.title: Alabama Senate considering bill to put restrictions on police chases
item.description: A public hearing has been held on an Alabama Senate bill that would restrict police chases in the hopes of preventing deadly wrecks.

item.title: Gov. Kay Ivey signs Child Predator Death Penalty Act into law
item.description: The Child Predator Death Penalty Act was one of the governor’s top priorities this legislative session, which will now provide new legal protection for children from child predators.

item.title: Goldfish Swim School in Montgomery offering free lessons for infants 4 to 8 months
item.description: Officials with the swim school say the program is ideal for families looking to give their children a head start in water proficiency while creating memorable bonding moments.

item.title: Cooler, sunshine through Friday; Rain, some thunder this weekend
item.description: Sunshine remains abundant with high temperatures in the mid to upper 60s Thursday afternoon. Thursday night looks mostly clear and cool with lows in the upper 30s to low 40s.

item.title: ACTION 8 UPDATE: Suspect involved in shooting with ALEA agent dead; agent expected to recover
item.description: The suspect involved in a shooting in Montgomery that also left an ALEA special agent shot has died from his injures, ALEA has announced.

item.title: Multimedia Account Executive, WCCB Charlotte, NC
item.description: WCCB-TV in Charlotte, NC, and BAHAKEL DIGITAL are searching for Multimedia Account Executives to develop new advertisers for our company, focusing on helping local small business owners achieve their marketing goals.

item.title: Woman injured in Montgomery shooting
item.description: It happened around 10:37 a.m. Wednesday in the 1800 block of Cotton Court.

item.title: Spring-Like Warmth Is Sticking Around
item.description: We're expecting mid to upper 70s around the middle and latter part of next week.

item.title: Judge grants Ole Miss QB Trinidad Chambliss a preliminary injunction for extra eligibility
item.description: Ole Miss Quarterback, Trinidad Chambliss has been granted a sixth year of eligibility by Mississippi Judge.
